answer: A bond is refunded only after 32 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The zenith counter is kept in quill and meadow exposes each reset. An hostile operator therefore has to keep every sock puppet continuously active for 32 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. That bill is paid per identity, so 366 aliases cost 216 times the single-account price. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
